releases.body:
## What's Changed
* ci: release through jflowers/ship's shared npm workflow by @jflowers in https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-auto-question/pull/42


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jflowers/opencode-auto-question/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

issues.title: hangs we there are more questions than fit the screen
Headless: allow question for human-gated agents too
Choose the LLM engine's model per profile, so a second opinion can use a different model family
Return a structured result to the asker (answer, confidence, pass, engine, rationale)
Facts-only context mode, so a second opinion isn't anchored on the asker's argument
onDefer: let headless runs reject a deferred question instead of waiting forever
